    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v in (8, 9) for v in grid[r])]

    base = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (8,9)), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    bg = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (8,9) and v != base)

    colors={v for row in grid for v in row}
    counts={v:sum(x==v for row in grid for x in row) for v in colors}
    # Identify ordinary interior fill as the most frequent color other than frame.
    # Sparse marker pairs encode positions in the reduced 2x2 result.
    markers=[v for v in colors if counts[v] <= 4]
    fill=min(colors, key=lambda v: counts[v])
    # Find each marker's average position and map to a quadrant.
    out=[[fill,fill],[fill,fill]]
    for v in markers:
        pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==v]
        r=sum(p[0] for p in pts)/len(pts); c=sum(p[1] for p in pts)/len(pts)
        out[0 if r < h/2 else 1][0 if c < w/2 else 1]=v
    return out
